name: Feature validation and direct neuron interventions

findings.finding: Goodfire tested native gated MLP units in Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Given generated descriptions, a judge distinguished firing passages from random text with 95% accuracy. Its token-wise activation simulations recovered 73% of the recoverable ablation damage in high-activation regimes. The released neuron atlas is linked from the paper. These measurements concern that MoE model, particular units and tests.

In factual recall and indirect-object identification, the corruption type, metric and patch extent changed which components appeared important. In one S-inhibition-head intervention, the restored logit difference was 1.04 with subject-token replacement and 0.49 with Gaussian noise. Preserve the signed logit difference and fully identify the matched source, destination and corruption.

Eight evaluation metrics across more than 200 released SAEs separate reconstruction and sparsity from downstream utility. Improvements on unsupervised proxies did not reliably predict practical performance. Feature absorption and disentanglement supplement standard reconstruction metrics.

On their Gemma-2 2B and 9B benchmark, plain prompting performed best on generation steering. Difference-in-means was a strong concept detector. Include simple behavior-only and support-trained contrast controls when testing the additional value of a dictionary.

The authors report 2–3-fold improvements in their steering experiments after filtering out features with weak output scores. Feature selection by input activation alone missed useful output directions. Their AxBench-style re-evaluation tunes strength on five instructions and evaluates on five others, with separate instruction-following and fluency scores. The gain is about steering and selected features, with a different sample from the original AxBench.

For related entity attributes, targeted interchange interventions can be tested both for changing the requested attribute and for preserving other attributes. Use the same idea to design public minimally different target/preserve prompts.

findings.source: Tan et al., September 2026 preprint, v2
findings.finding: SAEScientist-Bench evaluated 10 agent configurations on 20 Gemma-2-9B-IT concept-layer tasks, grading activation selectivity against hard negatives and neutral texts, and steering with instruction preservation. A documented agent chose a feature firing more on English control text than its intended Portuguese text. For one case the top-three activation mean distinguished a sustained response from a single-token spike. Appendix A.2 identifies evaluation reuse for the expert reference.

Gemma Scope 2 released Gemma 3 SAEs and transcoders. The technical report distinguishes pretraining and instruction-tuned distributions, activation sites and cross-layer model types. Its official 4B-IT model repository is a suitable optional compatible artifact source for Gemma, whereas on-the-fly dictionaries and native neurons remain usable on other supported targets.

existing_harness: src/iwi_harness/probes.py already supports a baseline and a temporary single-feature scale/clamp in the same call. It preserves the SAE reconstruction residual. It also provides matched contrasts, signed target-token margins when token IDs are supplied, generation of full replies, and feature_examples on public prompts with optional suppression of a single feature. A negative scalar for a native neuron can matter even though the existing SAE example summary emphasizes positive activation frequency.

src/iwi_harness/causal.py has gradient ranking of one or several component sites at the specified token position and independent exact source-to-target activation patching. The algorithm and exact measurements are already distinct. src/iwi_harness/targets.py registers whole attention/MLP branch outputs on supported architectures. Gemma's current MLP branch points to post_feedforward_layernorm. These are different sites from individual post-gate features feeding the down projection.

src/iwi_harness/targets.py pins one Gemma Scope 2 artifact, resid_post/layer_17_width_16k_l0_medium, for google/gemma-scope-2-4b-it. Runtime-fitted features already work on Gemma and Qwen through src/iwi_harness/dictionaries.py. src/iwi_harness/weights.py supports numeric scalar scaling of a selected column and hash-verified export/replay.

evidence/mechinterp-demonstration/feature-replay.json and examples/replay_mechinterp.py show the desired controls are feasible offline. Astra's chosen feature was first of eight for mean absolute margin change across 12 fresh wordings of six reviews (6.70 logits versus 5.81 for the runner-up). Only two first-token choices flipped, both on the same review. All-feature natural-activation comparisons do not independently match perturbation magnitude.

evidence/heldout-token-audit/tool-behavior.md records four inactive-feature retries, 13/15 editors seeing a nonzero result before their first write, and no submissions on the shared five-turn false-suggestion episode in all three harness layouts. In one other case an editor submitted a retry and its writes in the same API response so their parameters could not use the retry. A concise bundled test can save an editor round trip. Its savings and benefit need measurement.

Study-only CPU verification in iwi-harness-scope/interpretability-update/check_neuron_column.py and random-mlp-column-check.json used actual Transformers 4.57.6 Gemma3MLP and Qwen2MLP classes with small random weights. The harness exported and reapplied the numeric column edits on fresh clones. For 2 architectures × 2 dtypes × 3 factors (0, 0.5 and 1), all module outputs exactly matched the global all-token hook. Factor 0.3 showed a maximum absolute bfloat16 error of 0.000244140625 on both modules from operation ordering/rounding. Last-token-only masking disagreed with global scaling for every nonidentity factor. These measurements cover layer outputs on synthetic inputs.

proposed_updates.proposal: Expose one bounded causal comparison on support prompts as an option in the existing inspection surface. Input a live observation/candidate handle or small set of feature IDs, labeled public target/preserve pairs, two rendered token IDs or candidate completion strings, position/phase, and a strict target-work cap. An editor may construct its own dictionary or request an existing one. Share the pristine baseline and meter every extra forward. Report active support count, signed desired change by slice, sign agreement, temporary next-token flips, an identity control, and a short completed-answer or teacher-forced candidate score when supplied. Emit a few worst public counterexamples and a paged artifact handle. Calibrate on public examples, then score distinct public confirmation examples. Keep official hidden items, grades and selection out of this call.
proposed_updates.cost: Low-to-moderate. Wrap existing inspect/generate primitives and add teacher-forced sequence scores only where supported. For two multi-token candidate answers, use consistent chat-prefix tokenization, report candidate lengths and sum of conditional log probabilities as well as per-token normalization. For greedy public generation, use a predeclared exact parser when the label set allows. Equalize the editor API token/call and target compute budgets in the comparison.
proposed_updates.control: Select an alternate feature from the same dictionary/site using activation frequency and induced residual-delta norm on a separate public calibration set, and disclose the actual norm ratio or unavailable match. A zero-activation feature makes a useful negative control for software fidelity, but is a weak strength-matched behavioral comparator. Also report all-feature sweeps where the dictionary is small, the scale-one control and unhooked restoration.

proposed_updates.proposal: Add dictionary-free intermediate gated MLP units as a discoverable probe basis on verified dense adapters. A unit's scalar is the value after the architecture's gate nonlinearity and multiplication by its up projection, at the input to the down projection. Take layer, unit or small top-k shortlist, positions, direction and intervention scale, and return signed activation/hit counts plus the same support evidence interface. Preserve tokenizer/template, checkpoint, layer, component, source weight revision and feature basis identity. Expose a candidate down-projection column edit using existing slice writes only when that adapter certifies the mapping.
proposed_updates.cost: Moderate. Confirm hook semantics separately on dense Gemma 3 and Qwen2/Qwen2.5 paths using the pinned Transformers classes. Fused/tensor-parallel/expert-routed modules require their own routing, expert ID and parity tests, so report the unavailable capability until implemented. Hugging Face source and the included CPU fixture support the dense mathematical mapping.
proposed_updates.control: For y=Wz+b, scaling post-gate z[j] by s for every token and every invocation is algebraically equivalent to scaling column W[:,j] by s when the linear map is untied and otherwise unmodified. Compare both paths on identical prefixes, fresh replays, factor one and fresh greedy outputs, with explicit numerical tolerances. A one-token ablation is a different treatment. This equivalence tests plumbing and gives a specific candidate, without guaranteeing a useful permanent edit.

proposed_updates.proposal: Treat feature labels from an external atlas as optional hypotheses. Bind a compatible checkpoint, dictionary SHA, implementation/site, normalization and index along with positive, near-miss and negative examples. Return the label only on request and remeasure a public control on the target's current weight revision. Use SAE Bench evaluations offline when choosing/pre-validating a pretrained dictionary. Preserve the option to fit a task-local dictionary on unsupported checkpoint/dictionary combinations.
proposed_updates.cost: Moderate for one pinned compatible Gemma artifact. A universal dictionary catalog and full circuit tracer are separate infrastructure and need evidence that probes currently fail for lack of that capability.

validation: Use replay on the 12 existing wordings to test implementation parity. For utility, pre-register new tasks unavailable during development and group by distinct base prompt/episode, treating wording variants and seeds as repeated measures. Cross discovery and public confirmation sets before locking the permanent candidate. Account for zero-active measurements and no-submissions explicitly.

Primary package experiment should compare the current compact harness, with its existing SAE tools, against the same harness plus bounded comparison. For information attribution, include an active control with the same tool schema, task examples, calls, costs and delivery timing but with an alternate calibrated direction's measurements or a declared behavior-only report. Prevent leakage via raw activations, operand handles or other tools that would reconstruct the withheld result. Harvest true and control measurements identically. Keep writes available in every arm, given the same editor and target, fixed turn caps, target-forward budgets and hidden verifier.

A separate held-out 2x2 public-support test crosses intended changed behavior with a nuisance factor (for arithmetic, suggestion truth and template wording; for remapping, mapping and explicit ordinary-label override). Keep target success and initially correct target/control retention by slice. Report official reward, paired fixes and breaks, correct full generated answer, signed next-token/sequence likelihood changes, no-submissions, target cost and editor tokens. Analyze by episode and editor seed, not 12 independent reviews.

Set acceptance or noninferiority margins and sample size from development data before accessing new private evaluations. A feature's claimed selectivity fails if a matched control yields similar signed effects or if answer-level targets are unchanged once the hook is removed in the submitted model. Classify reproducible hook effects separately from signed transfer. Promote the capability only if its paired editor outcomes support the declared quality/retention claim or comparable quality costs materially fewer resources.
limitations: Semantic interpretability of individual Goodfire MoE neurons and highly activating inputs does not imply all dense neurons or arbitrary residual coordinates are suitable edit targets. A native MLP intermediate coordinate and a coordinate of the post-block residual stream have different meanings.

Arad et al. and AxBench evaluate activation steering. Their results motivate controls and output-aware selection. They do not establish cross-task persistent improvements from an SAE or a universal parameter map.

Neither an object's name nor the largest absolute movement in a two-token margin identifies a persistent edit. Cross-check direction, full generated behavior, support controls and private retention after fresh numerical patch replay. A tiny learned dictionary can reconstruct a support set well yet remain poorly aligned with transfer.

Generalization to additional model families, any effect on benchmark reward, uptake by open-weight updaters and the cost-benefit tradeoff of new tools remain experimental questions. No external agent service integration, hosted editor rollout or production runtime change was performed for this research item.
